# Go codegen for map<K,V>: literal, index, and method dispatch.

sngl generate --platform=bubbletea --lang=go --out=out app.sngl
exists out/model.go

# Map field declared with correct Go type on Model struct.
grep 'scores map\[string\]int' out/model.go

# New() initialises the map literal: map[string]int{"alice": 10, "bob": 20}.
grep '"alice": 10' out/model.go
grep '"bob": 20' out/model.go

# map.length() dispatches to len(m.scores) in the handler.
grep 'len\(m\.scores\)' out/model.go

# map.get() dispatches to an inline if-ok-idiom.
grep 'func\(\) any' out/model.go

-- app.sngl --
output { go { bubbletea } }

component main {
    var scores map<string, int> = {alice = 10, bob = 20}
    var size = 0
    button(text="count", @click {
        size = scores.length()
    })
    button(text="check", @click {
        size = scores.get("alice", 0)
    })
    text(value=string(size))
}
